Insurance loss adjustment in the UAE

COGS Global provides independent loss adjustment and survey services for UAE insurers, reinsurers and brokers. Our adjusters combine engineering and insurance expertise to establish cause of loss, quantum, and mitigation recommendations.

Lines of business

  • Marine cargo and hull
  • Fire and property damage
  • Engineering — CAR, EAR, machinery breakdown
  • Liability and miscellaneous claims
  • Catastrophic and large-loss events

Our process

  1. Instruction and conflict checks; file opening with insurer/broker
  2. Site survey, joint inspections, and evidence collection
  3. Interim updates for reserving where required
  4. Final adjustment report with quantum and settlement support

Survey vs loss adjustment vs valuation

ActivityPrimary outputTypical appointor
SurveyFactual damage / cause reportInsurer, broker
Loss adjustmentQuantum and settlement recommendationInsurer panel
Reinstatement valuationSum insured / reinstatement basisInsurer, bank

Frequently asked questions

What is a loss adjuster in the UAE?

A loss adjuster investigates insurance claims on behalf of insurers and stakeholders, assesses cause and quantum of loss, and prepares impartial reports to support fair settlement. In the UAE, firms such as COGS Global operate under Central Bank licensing requirements for insurance survey and loss adjustment.

Who can appoint COGS Global?

Insurers, reinsurers, and insurance brokers typically appoint us under panel agreements or per-instruction bases. Insured parties may also encounter our adjusters when we are nominated by the insurer to conduct joint surveys.

Which lines of business do you adjust in the UAE?

We handle marine cargo and hull, property and fire, engineering (CAR/EAR, machinery breakdown), liability and miscellaneous claims, including complex and catastrophic events.

Do you support insurer panel onboarding?

Yes. We provide credentials, license documentation, and indicative service standards for technical and procurement review. Contact us to request panel documentation.

Can you coordinate cross-border files with India?

Where claims involve UAE and India exposures, our IRDAI-registered India operations can support under a single coordination point from Dubai headquarters.
